ALPHABET CENTER · LETTER I

Letter I — Ice Cream.

The letter I melts in with an ice cream cone. I is the only letter that introduces itself by name here — ice starts with ie, just like the letter’s own name.

Meet the letter, hear its sound, trace it together — then play. Everything on this page is free, gentle and paced for you.

THE LETTER SOUND

What does I say?

“i — ie, ice cream starts with I’s name sound”

Ice cream starts with I’s name sound: ie. The little i also has a short ih sound, as in insect — for now, meet the long ie of ice, the one your child already says when they shout ice cream!

The little i also says its short ih sound, as in insect. Ice cream meets the long ie first — the one children already know.

TRACE THE LETTER

Trace I i together.

Follow the numbers with a finger — on screen or on each other’s palms. The arrows show the way to go, the numbers show where to start, and a grown-up reads the little script below each card. Slow and wobbly is exactly right.

Trace the uppercase I

Start at 1 at the top, pull straight down. Lift. Start at 2 at the top, slide across. Lift. Slide across the bottom.

Trace the lowercase i

Start at 1, pull straight down. Lift. Dot the little line above — that is 2.

TAKE IT OFF SCREEN

Ice cream shop.

Two minutes is plenty. Follow your child’s lead and stop while it is still fun — that is the whole method.

  1. 01

    Open an ice cream shop with paper scoops and a wooden spoon for a scoop.

  2. 02

    Every order starts with ie, ie, ice cream!

  3. 03

    Pay for each cone with a hug — the shop accepts nothing else.

PLAY & PRACTICE

Games that use this letter.

The games mix every letter — play them after meeting two or three letters, or any day your child asks. No scores, no timers, no wrong answers that count.
